trials.name: L5: a call site restates a length instead of asking the region
trials.note: Re-anchored 2026-09-15: this cited the manifest staging (`manifest.ptr()`/`manifest.capacity()`), which no longer exists — the native host hands the kernel a real image instead of a v3 manifest, so the kernel allocates its own buffer and pulls bytes through `host_image_read`. The invariant is unchanged and `run_guest_inner` still allocates `prefix_scratch` and `root_scratch` through `KernelScratch`, so the trial moved to a surviving site rather than being retired. The deleted site is why the floor in `a_scratch_pointer_never_travels_without_its_own_capacity` went 9 -> 8.
